description: Issue truth of the deterministic failing batch. The fake failure-analysis/triage agents materialize one AI issue for the first failing case per batch, titled with the `P7 失败分析：` prefix and the case title. issue_false_positive_rate = (AI issues - true positive issues) / AI issues (threshold <= 0.05); the runner matches an AI issue to a truth row by its stable title.
